title: helichrysum rupestre subsp. valentinum
intro: Helichrysum rupestre subsp. valentinum, commonly known as Island Helichrysum or Corsican Helichrysum, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the sunflower family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may aid in reducing stress and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Island Helichrysum are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce pain, and promote relaxation. The plant contains bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
